evidence.canon_identity_note: One contact identity flavor is kept. core/src/identity/keys.rs still addresses contacts and store entries by public-key hex; the change inside verify_bundle is a control-flow simplification of the same has_mldsa condition (both ML-DSA fields present -> V3 branch, otherwise the legacy Ed25519 path, unchanged), with no new address flavor and no change to what is stored or compared.
evidence.recipient_parse_note: Recipient and key parsing from untrusted input is free of unwrap/expect on main, and the change made it more so. The two .as_ref().expect('... verified Some by has_mldsa check') calls in core/src/identity/keys.rs verify_bundle became one if let (Some(mldsa_public), Some(mldsa_signature)) binding of the same condition, so a bundle carrying only one ML-DSA field takes the legacy Ed25519 path exactly as before and a malformed bundle can no longer abort the process. Non-key recipients are still rejected: hex decode returns Option and a wrong-length or non-hex recipient is refused by the same checks as before (core/src/identity/keys.rs hex::decode -> ok()?, length/format validation). No unwrap/expect remains anywhere in the recipient/key surface - see identity_parse_scan for the scoped gate runs.

The 56 registered sites are all outside the recipient/key surface: 50 in core/src/transport/**, 4 in core/src/routing/**, 2 in core/src/mobile_bridge.rs (get_global_runtime's fatal Tokio-runtime invariant) - clock, multiaddr-literal, parking_lot-poisoning and runtime-creation invariants, none of them a recipient or key parse.

The only change in a routing-globbed path is core/src/iron_core.rs's #[doc(hidden)] test-only helper test_only_identity_signing_key, which now returns Option<SigningKey> instead of expecting an initialised identity; its four call sites are in core/tests. core/src/routing/**, core/src/transport/** and core/src/mobile_bridge.rs are not in the diff at all, so no transport callback reaches routing state through anything new.
